# manhwaindex

> manhwaindex is a legal availability index for manhwa, manga, manhua and anime.
> For any title, it names the official platforms that are licensed to carry it,
> and links straight to them. It hosts no chapters and no episodes, and it never
> links to unlicensed copies.

Data source: AniList, plus MyAnimeList scores. The site rebuilds every day, so
platform lists and airing dates stay current.

## Scope

- About 2,500 comics (manhwa, manga, manhua)
- About 1,000 anime series and films
- About 14,000 characters
- Every title page lists official reading or streaming platforms, the price
  model of each one (free, free tier, paid chapters, subscription, print),
  status, chapter or episode count, author or studio, genres and related titles.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://manhwaindex.com/) — search and browse everything
- [Manhwa](https://manhwaindex.com/manhwa) — Korean comics
- [Manga](https://manhwaindex.com/manga) — Japanese comics
- [Manhua](https://manhwaindex.com/manhua) — Chinese comics
- [Anime](https://manhwaindex.com/anime) — anime series and films
- [Genres](https://manhwaindex.com/genre) — every genre
- [Characters](https://manhwaindex.com/character) — characters
- [Where to read](https://manhwaindex.com/where-to-read) — every official manhwa site, free and paid
- [Where to watch](https://manhwaindex.com/where-to-watch) — every legal anime streaming service, free ones first
- [Sitemap](https://manhwaindex.com/sitemap.xml) — full URL index

## How to cite

Cite the title page URL, for example
[Solo Leveling](https://manhwaindex.com/manhwa/solo-leveling). Each title page carries a single
plain-language sentence that answers "where can I legally read or watch this",
followed by the full platform table.
